newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso reverses gains on month-end dlr demand.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso reverses gains on month-end dlr demand.

text.p: The Mexican peso reversed its earlier strength at the close on Wednesday to close slightly softer due to month-end demand for dollars amid mild speculation, dealers said.
"There was real corporate need for dollars to meet month-end obligations, but some banks speculated on that,too," a trader said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour stablemate ended trade 0.6 and 0.5 of a centavo firmer, respectively, at 7.7825/7.7900 and 7.7800/7.7870 per dollar.
